data.name: Winged Sakura: Mindy's Arc
data.detailed_description:
Winged Sakura: Mindy's Arc is a fast-paced, anime-themed Strategy Defense game with RPG mechanics that tells the story of Mindy Akumori, a weak girl who is suffering from amnesia. The story takes place in an unknown dimensional world where Mindy is trapped inside a mysterious building. The building contains a Sakura Platform that allows her to teleport to various locations within the dimensional world, known as Entrances.

In this era, Sakura (also known as Cherry Blossoms) are magical flowers that grant humans the ability to become Sakura Contractors, giving them extraordinary powers. If the Contractor dies, the Sakura dies. If the Sakura dies, the Contractor dies.

Will Mindy recover her memories? Will she survive and make it back to her world alive? Help Mindy and become her savior.

Key Features

  • A Brand New Innovative Defense System: The characters (Spirits) you summon onto the battlefield are stationary and only remain active for a few seconds. You have complete control over each Spirit's target, but they disappear if an enemy collides with them.

  • Strategic Pause: Plan your moves, queue up actions, and take all the time you need. There's no rush. Enjoy the game at your own pace.

  • Leveling Up System: Unlock a total of 16 Spirits and level them up to 99!

  • Skill System: Customize your playstyle with a skill tree featuring 12 Active Skills and 8 Passive Skills. Experiment and discover the build that's right for you.

  • An Expandable Shop System: After successfully completing a level, the shop has a chance to permanently unlock a new item. Expand the shop until you've unlocked every item in the game!

  • Crafting and Enchanting System: Enchant your equipment up to a maximum level of 99! Discover crafting recipes and create powerful items for all of your Spirits.

  • Survival Mode (End game content): After completing the main game, put your skills to the test in our endless Survival Mode. A total of 4 additional Spirits can be unlocked in this mode. Are you good enough to conquer the challenge and unlock all 16 Spirits?

  • Steam Leaderboards: Compete against other players and show off your skills. Do you have what it takes to earn a place on the Insane Mode Leaderboards? (An internet connection is required for full Steam Leaderboards functionality. Steam Leaderboards can be disabled in the in-game options.)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 64 Bit
  • Processor: SSE2 Instruction Set Support (Any CPU after 2007)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Shader Model 2.0 (Any GPU after 2007)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 1500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: A widescreen monitor is recommended. (16:9 or 16:10 aspect ratio). Art's native resolution is 1080p. Scaling will occur on any other resolutions.
